mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mobi_points_log pl WHERE pl.shop_id IN AND pl.action_type = 2 AND pl.status IN (1, 5) AND pl.create_time >= #{startTime} AND pl.create_time < #{endTime}
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(ABS(IFNULL(pl.change_base, 0)) + ABS(IFNULL(pl.change_bonus, 0))), 0) FROM mobi_points_log pl WHERE pl.shop_id IN AND pl.action_type = 2 AND AND >= #{startTime} AND < #{endTime}

SELECT pl.shop_id AS shopId, IFNULL(SUM(IFNULL(pl.change_base, 0) + IFNULL(pl.change_bonus, 0)), 0) AS increasePoints FROM mobi_points_log pl WHERE pl.shop_id IN AND pl.action_type = 1 AND pl.create_time >= #{startTime} AND pl.create_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY pl.shop_id

SELECT DATE(su.create_time) AS statDate, COUNT(DISTINCT su.user_id) AS newUsers FROM mobi_shop_user su WHERE su.shop_id IN AND su.role IN (3, 4) AND su.create_time >= #{startTime} AND su.create_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE(su.create_time)

SELECT DATE(pl.create_time) AS statDate, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM mobi_points_log pl WHERE pl.shop_id IN AND pl.action_type = 2 AND pl.status IN (1, 5) AND pl.create_time >= #{startTime} AND pl.create_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE(pl.create_time)

SELECT DATE() AS statDate, IFNULL(SUM(ABS(IFNULL(pl.change_base, 0)) + ABS(IFNULL(pl.change_bonus, 0))), 0) AS pointsUsed FROM mobi_points_log pl WHERE pl.shop_id IN AND pl.action_type = 2 AND AND >= #{startTime} AND < #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE()

SELECT DATE(pl.create_time) AS statDate, IFNULL(SUM(IFNULL(pl.change_base, 0) + IFNULL(pl.change_bonus, 0)), 0) AS increasePoints FROM mobi_points_log pl WHERE pl.shop_id IN AND pl.action_type = 1 AND pl.create_time >= #{startTime} AND pl.create_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE(pl.create_time)
